differs.layout: A half-circle slice rising from the bottom edge, centred, with the copy top left, labelled moments in two columns either side and today's card top right, instead of a full log face-on beside a copy column with a plaque at its heart.
differs.mechanic: Each finished ring drives a pin and a leader out to its side column, alternating left and right so the story stacks upward in time, instead of one callout riding a diagonal measuring line ring by ring.
differs.data: One ordered list of dated company moments plus today's headcount read from content, with years written up the slice, instead of a yearly order volume that sets ring width and sums to a total.
differs.moment: The outermost ring, today, flushes with the accent colour and a leader climbs from it to a card with the team count, instead of the heart plaque landing on a running total.

blurb: A company's years as a half-cut log rising from the bottom edge: one ring per year from the founding, each moment pinned out to the side, and today's outer ring opening onto the team count.
